marks.gloss_en: as the nesher -- no extra digit, no crop, gizzard not peeled, clawing -- is tamei, so every bird like it
as doves -- extra digit, crop, peelable gizzard, no clawing -- are tahor, so every bird like them
לא נאמר פירושן מדברי תורה אלא מדברי סופרים (= p_abaye_perushan)
the baraita: as the nesher is distinctive -- no extra digit, no crop, its gizzard not peeled, it claws and eats -- and is tamei, so every bird like it is tamei
ולילף מתורין: as doves have all four signs, so here -- not until all four are present
אם כן, שאר עופות טמאין דכתב רחמנא למה לי? -- then the Torah's list of the other non-kosher birds would be superfluous
ונילף מינייהו: as there three [signs] and we do not eat, so every bird with three, and all the more two or one
אם כן, עורב דכתב רחמנא למה לי? -- if one with three is forbidden, need the crow with two be stated?
נשר דלית ליה כלל הוא דלא תיכול, הא איכא דאית ליה חד -- תיכול
R' Chiya: a bird that comes with one sign is tahor
